statements.subject: message
statements.description: By including the MTag given in or with the session description in an If-Match header part of the SETUP request, the client ensures that resources set up are matching the description.
statements.guard_semantics: client includes MTag from session description to enforce resource-description integrity

statements.subject: server
statements.description: A SETUP request with the If-Match header for which the MTag validation check fails MUST generate a response using 412 (Precondition Failed).
statements.trigger: SETUP request received with If-Match header
statements.pre_cond: message.method = SETUP & message.header.IfMatch != null & server.MTag_validation = failed
